controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-nginx.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:02:22.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:02:22.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| STATS events = COUNT(*)
        BY url.path, http.request.method, source.ip, http.response.status_code
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 20
